kits.title: Bloom Next.js People Operations Dashboard Template
kits.summary: Production-ready People Operations dashboard for org charts, recruiting pipelines, employee directories, attrition analytics, performance reviews, profiles, and HR settings.
kits.description: Bloom is a production-ready People Operations and HR dashboard built as a real multi-route Next.js application. It combines an interactive pan-and-zoom organization chart, keyboard-accessible hiring kanban, searchable employee directory, CSV export, attrition analytics, performance-review cycles, detailed employee profiles, command search, notifications, persistent settings, and responsive light and dark themes. Its typed demo data and reusable application shell make it a strong starting point for HRIS, recruiting, workforce analytics, talent management, and internal people platforms.

kits.title: Aisle Next.js Retail and DTC Operations Dashboard Template
kits.summary: Retail and DTC operations dashboard for merchandising, products, orders, inventory, fulfillment, replenishment, category performance, and operator settings.
kits.description: Aisle is a polished retail and direct-to-consumer operations dashboard built for ecommerce brands, inventory products, fulfillment platforms, and retail-tech applications. The Next.js source includes a revenue-led overview, product catalog with real photography, quick view, advanced orders table, order detail drawer, optimistic status changes, inventory health, restock workflows, sales heatmaps, category performance, global search, settings, responsive navigation, and persistent themes. A realistic deterministic dataset connects 52 products, 100 orders, inventory, customers, and category metrics across the application.

kits.title: Cadence Next.js Inventory Forecasting SaaS Landing Page Template
kits.summary: Conversion-focused B2B SaaS landing page for inventory intelligence, demand forecasting, replenishment, purchase orders, and multichannel retail operations.
kits.description: Cadence is a premium B2B SaaS landing page designed for inventory intelligence and demand-forecasting products. Its 13-section conversion journey combines a predictive forecast hero, operational proof, interactive visualizations, process storytelling, product deep-dives, quantified case studies, monthly and yearly pricing, integrations, FAQ, validated contact and newsletter forms, final CTA, and responsive footer. A warm editorial design, WCAG-aware light and dark themes, scroll-linked motion, typed content data, and reusable sections make Cadence a distinctive foundation for retail, DTC, supply-chain, and ecommerce software launches.
